CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit origin/access record, and separate content listing are present for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition explicitly linked to content presentation or access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple literal content labels and attributes (color buckets with explicit coordinate sets) are identified.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from an explicit origin/access record for the same referent and time, distinguishing identity from status/access metadata.

O.rationale: The report states display orientation rules and includes explicit origin/represented_time metadata describing how content is represented/accessed.
